headline: Kuwait Confirms Drone Incident at Ali Al Salem Base
deck: Kuwaiti officials attributed Wednesday’s drone incident to Iran, while an Iranian account described claimed targets without a confirmed result.
body: On Wednesday, Kuwait condemned what Kuwait Times reported as repeated Iranian attacks, saying the latest had been carried out with drones. The Foreign Ministry called the attacks a violation of Kuwaiti sovereignty and a threat to its security and stability, and said they breached international law, the U.N. Charter and Security Council Resolution 2817. [E1][E2][E3]

AP reported, citing Iran’s state broadcaster, that Iranian military forces had fired at air-defense systems and drone and missile launch platforms at Ali Al Salem air base. Kuwait’s military said its air defenses intercepted drone attacks and did not immediately report damage, leaving the Iranian account without a confirmed result for the systems it named. [E6][E7]

The Foreign Ministry said Kuwait reserved the right to take measures to safeguard its sovereignty and vital facilities, grounding that position in its asserted right of self-defense under Article 51 of the U.N. Charter and the rules of international law. [E4][E5]
